description.narrative: The goal of this network activity is mainly to build the capacity of Healthy People Rwanda and IMCC-FAIR to network with other organizations across the world which share similar cause. These will be achieved by attending the nineth Global meeting prepared by the Global Alliance of NGOs for Road Safety as well as fourth Global ministerial Conference on Road safety. Both conferences will happen simultaneously at the same place. These events will be the biggest gathering of road safety NGOs, ministries, and road safety institutions and the most important events leading up to trigger stronger action to reduce road deaths by 50% by 2030. It will feature practical workshops that showcase the practices known to save lives, a symposium that focuses on investment in evidence-based interventions, and a street-activation that calls for action and demonstrates that every life matters and that no one should die in a crash.
